title.narrative: Enhancing human security in priority municipalities in Senegal border regions with the security, climate change and migration nexus. (Reference Number: UDP-AF-23-008: Senegal) (PARSH)

description.narrative: The programme aims to enhance the integration of the Human Security (HS) approach in the two most susceptible border municipalities of Boki Diawé and Mbolo Birane, located in Senegal’s Sahelian zone and the border region with Mauritania. To promote social connectedness 1, the programme will mainstream human security into local planning and community practices for greater citizens’ participation. It will also aim to strengthen anticipative and prevention planning in local governance with the strengthening of competencies on “prevention-centred” planning, and the organisations of community ideation workshops to drill down and ascertain the real causes of challenges faced on the ground and by promoting solutions that are in themselves sustainable, resilient and contributing to HS in both municipalities. In addition, the programme will help the communities build social cohesion and increase their resilience to external shocks (e.g., rise in cost of commodities, change in government policies, pandemics, floods, droughts etc.) especially for women, youth, and marginalized groups such as refugees and migrant populations ?, with the piloting of a data-centred tool enabling the development of early warning mechanisms that help to mitigate the impact of current threats and, where possible, prevent the occurrence of future challenges
